name: handy-eff
description: Form a frame with your hands like a film director, and watch 10 high-fidelity cinematic, posterized, holographic, and glassmorphic visual effects warp live strictly inside the bounding shape of your fingers.

🌐 Try the Web App Directly in Your Browser! • 🎬 View All 10 Effects • 🚀 Quickstart

Whether you're exploring computer vision, creating eye-catching social media content, or just having fun directing real-time video, Hand Frame FX transforms your webcam into a dynamic visual FX studio.
features: 🌐 Universal Dual Engine: Run instantly in any modern web browser via Vercel (web/ folder with OpenCV.js & MediaPipe Vision), or run natively on desktop with maximum Python/OpenCV performance (handyeff.py).

🔷 Dynamic Quadrilateral & Triangular Masking: Form a 4-point frame with both hands (index tips and thumb tips) to create a quadrilateral mask. Pinch one hand to collapse its anchors into a single vertex for a sharp…

⚡ Permissive High-Speed Tracking: Leverages MediaPipe landmark detection with exponential corner smoothing (SMOOTH = 0.55) to eliminate edge jitter and keep the bounding shape rock-solid even during rapid movement.
👐 Natural Gesture Controls: Bring your two hands together (Clap) to automatically cycle to the next visual effect without touching the keyboard. Spread them apart to re-arm.

🎥 Real-Time Clean Recording: Capture composite creations on the fly. The built-in recorder saves a pristine feed of the final output (free of developer skeletons or UI overlays) at a constant, true-to-speed 30 FPS.
